newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania anti-government protesters and police clash.
newsitem.headline: Albania anti-government protesters and police clash.

text.p: Anti-government protesters hurled stones and Albanian riot police fired shots in the air to drive them off during demonstrations in Tirana on Thursday, eyewitnesses said.
The clashes took place after some 7,000 anti-government protesters demonstrated peacefully at a soccer field.
The witnesses said police waded in with truncheons, hitting demonstrators indiscriminately and firing in the air to break up the violent protesters. Scores of stones were thrown during the clash.

Police permitted the demonstration by opposition parties in an outer suburb of the capital. The latest incident followed a month of riots and protests across Albania after five fraudulent pyramid investment schemes collapsed.
Witnesses said that the police had again taken control of the situation and were ordering people to disperse into side streets and leave the area.
